title: A closed tumor-immune-brain circuit in cancer cachexia
authors: Felix Clemens Richter, Joel Xu En Wong, Andreas Bergthaler
abstract: Cancer-associated cachexia is a complex metabolic syndrome leading to sustained body weight loss and tissue wasting. In this issue of Cancer Cell, Shi et al. identify a novel GDF15-driven tumor-immune-brain crosstalk, resulting in altered systemic metabolism and tissue catabolism.
